FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.Enabled.Name: Enable bridge
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.Enabled.Hint: Connect this Foundry tab to the local relay on the configured URL. Disable to fully shut down the WebSocket.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.RelayUrl.Name: Relay URL
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.RelayUrl.Hint: WebSocket URL of the local relay. Default: ws://127.0.0.1:7878. Only localhost addresses make sense; remote URLs are not supported by design.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.NOTIFY.Refused: Foundry-Claude bridge refused by relay (check capability config).
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.NOTIFY.SecondListener: A second AAGM-C instance tried to connect and was refused. Only one loop can drain the chat box.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.MenuHint: Mode presets, Chain Mode, and the local Macro Mirror.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.Modeassistant.Hi: AAGM assists at your table; every change is individually confirmed. (Default)
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.Modecogm.Name: Co-GM Mode
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.Modecogm.Hint: AAGM works alongside you: multitasking and Chain Mode offers. Assumes an experienced GM.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.Modecustom.Name: Custom
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.OptsLegend: Options (set by the mode unless Custom)
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.Multitasking.Hin: Claude may run background workers for heavy builds while still answering the chat box. One voice, writes still confirmed one at a time.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.ChainOffers.Name: Chain Mode offers
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.ChainOffers.Hint: For big same-shaped batches, Claude may offer ONE approval covering the whole batch. Never covers deletes or lethal outcomes; any surprise reverts to per-change confirms.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.ChainThreshold.N: Offer a chain at this many gates:
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.ChainMax.Name: Maximum chain length:
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.MirrorEnabled.Hi: Lets Claude back up world macros to a local folder on the machine running the relay ("back up all the macros"), and restore from it. Backups never delete; old versions become .bkp files.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.MirrorPath.Name: Local directory:
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.MirrorSort.Name: Use Contextual sorting? (Experimental)
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.MirrorSort.Hint: Claude files each macro into the local folder that mostly matches its Foundry folder ("✓ System" matches "System"). No confident match creates the literal folder name instead.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.SETTINGS.Saved: AAGM-C settings saved and synced to the relay.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.CHAT.Title: Claude Code Chat
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.CHAT.NotConnected: Unable to Connect to Claude Code, Please Check Connections
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.CHAT.StatusNoListener: Connected to the relay, but no Claude Code listener is running. Start a /loop in Claude Code - messages will queue until then.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.CHAT.StatusDisconnected: Lost connection to the relay. Check that the relay process is running and the bridge module is enabled.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.CHAT.Placeholder: Type a message for Claude Code…  (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline, /exit stops the listener)
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.CHAT.ReplyWhileClosed: Claude Code replied, but the chat box is closed. Reopen "Open Claude Code Chat" to see it.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.CHAT.ConfirmWrite: Claude Code wants to make a change - review
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.CHAT.ConfirmAgain: Are you sure? This is destructive. Approve again to proceed.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.CHAT.ChainActive: ⛓ CHAIN MODE active - approved batch running
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.LOOT.Armed: Claude Loot Watchdog ARMED. Run the macro again to disarm.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.LOOT.NoJournal: Claude Loot Watchdog: rescue log journal not found at
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.LOOT.Vanish: LOOT WATCHDOG: an item vanished in transfer. Queued for Claude auto-restore; see the Rescue Log.
FOUNDRY_BRIDGE.LOOT.Phantom: LOOT WATCHDOG: phantom 'trait as loot' detected. Held for review; see the Rescue Log.
